items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee states 'We’re very, very good friends' referring to Al Schmitt, not Al Jarreau. Al Jarreau is only mentioned by the interviewer as the person through whom the interviewer knows Al Schmitt.

ctx.x: He’s got more Grammys than anybody.
Al Schmitt, oh yeah. I know him because of – through his association with Al Jarreau. Beautiful. Yeah, Al. Well, that fills in that gap.
Fabulous. We’re very, very good friends. He’s got quite a history, going back to Sam Cooke days.
